name: The Five Senses
overview: Scripture reveals that the five senses are divinely designed gifts that connect us to God's creation and His truth. The hearing ear and the seeing eye are explicitly made by the LORD (Proverbs 20:12), emphasizing His sovereign craftsmanship (Psalms 115:3). Through taste and sight, believers are invited to experience the goodness of God (Psalms 34:8), while the imagery of smell in Genesis 8:21 reflects God's responsive heart toward mankind. These verses collectively affirm that our senses are not merely physical faculties but channels through which we perceive and respond to the Lord’s work and presence.
